derived_sentence: The overall score of 0.2477 hid the severity of the problem. At night, performance fell to 0.1667 and for nighttime pedestrians, it dropped to just 0.0826.
headline: Aggregate accuracy was hiding a night-driving blind spot.
miss_sentence: The problem was widespread: the detector missed at least one object in 60 of the 62 nighttime test frames.
problem_sentence: At first, the detector seemed to perform reasonably well. But when we looked at different driving conditions, a major weakness appeared: at night, its ability to detect pedestrians dropped dramatically.
